NOW THEREFORE I. Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. Piyal Darshana Guruge, Attorney-at-law, No. 04, Richard De Soyza Housing Scheme, Koswatta, Battaramulla. to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.

Mr. K. A. Jagath P. Perera, “Priyandi”, Convent Road, Kalamulla, Kalutara. and
Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau, 80, Galle Road, Colombo 03. STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. K.A.Jagath P. Perera working in the Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau has been caused injustice by not receiving the post of Junior Manager from 23rd March 2010 and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
